text.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a new narrative speech scene after the sale report
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links back to the prior sale report while letting the scene change register. The ayah does not simply continue the transaction; it opens a voiced household moment in which the buyer's speech becomes the next narrative beat.

topics.headline: resumptive opening into speech
topics.reason: The particle is an opening conjunction, and the following speech verb supports a scene shift from transaction summary into reported speech.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening connector moves from the sale report into a new voiced household scene.

words.gloss_range: completed reported saying that governs a direct quotation containing command and hope
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speech, declaration, and reported utterance; here narrowed to a completed narrative speech act
words.prose: {{ar:قَالَ}} ({{tr:qāla}}) turns the narrative from silent commerce into reported speech. As a perfect verb, it frames the buyer's utterance as a completed act, and the quote it opens holds both command and uncertainty: a directive to the wife, then hoped-for benefit or adoption. As one of Surah 12's repeated speech hinges, this buyer's saying also joins the larger chain of claims, commands, and later household voices.

topics.headline: completed speech act governs the quote
topics.reason: The perfect speech verb precedes its subject and governs the quoted command through the adoption proposal.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the buyer's words form one completed quote holding both command and uncertainty.

topics.headline: one node in a wider speech pattern
topics.reason: The same-surah speech pattern is useful background, but the local prose keeps the focus on this utterance's command and hope structure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps this buyer speech as one node in Surah 12's larger chain of reported speech scenes.

words.gloss_range: definite relative pronoun identifying the speaker by the act of purchasing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) gives the speaker a definite identity without naming him. The relative clause defines him by the act that brought Yusuf into the household, so his narrative role is buyer before it is name, rank, or lineage.

topics.headline: definite but unnamed buyer
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is the subject of both the saying and the buying clause, so the speaker is identified through his purchase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the buyer is made definite but remains unnamed, defined by purchasing Yusuf.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII completed buying/acquiring with Yusuf as attached object; the broader sell-buy exchange range is locally narrowed toward acquisition
words.root_gloss_range: exchange range including selling, buying, trading, and acquiring; Form VIII and context select buying for oneself here
words.prose: {{ar:ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ}} ({{tr:ishtarāhu}}) completes the transaction from the buyer's side. The attached object keeps Yusuf as the definite purchased one, while Form VIII narrows the broad exchange root toward acquisition for the household. The word still carries the pressure of commerce, but the local grammar does not make selling and buying equally active at once.

topics.headline: exchange root narrowed to buying
topics.reason: The Form VIII perfect with an object suffix and Egyptian buyer context select acquisition rather than disposal.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the local buying/acquiring sense from the broader sell-buy exchange range.

topics.headline: Yusuf carried as definite object
topics.reason: The object suffix marks Yusuf as the purchased object before later clauses recast him as honored resident and taught recipient.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same Yusuf-referent from purchased object toward honored resident and taught recipient.

words.gloss_range: source preposition marking Egyptian provenance
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) marks the buyer's provenance through the following place-name. It gives the scene a concrete Egyptian source before the ayah later widens the scale to the land as the domain of divine establishment.

topics.headline: source relation before wider domain
topics.reason: The preposition governs the place-name as the source complement of the buying verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the scene begin with concrete Egyptian provenance before widening to the land.

words.gloss_range: proper place-name Egypt, syntactically governed by the source preposition, with bounded-city undertone only as background
words.root_gloss_range: Egypt as a proper place-name, with older range around a city, settled center, or bounded region; local use selects the proper place
words.prose: {{ar:مِصْرَ}} ({{tr:miṣra}}) is governed by the source preposition and functions as a proper place-name without needing a definite article. The diptote shape supports that local reading. Claims about a generic metropolis can be kept only as background pressure, because this scene needs the marked Egyptian setting.

topics.headline: proper place-name under source preposition
topics.reason: The form is tagged as a proper noun and is governed as the complement of the source preposition.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader treats Egypt as a marked proper place-name, not a vague location.

topics.headline: city or metropolis undertone only
topics.reason: The common city range is documented, but the local grammar and narrative setting select the proper place-name.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retains the bounded-city undertone while keeping Egypt as the selected local referent.

words.gloss_range: dative preposition marking the wife as recipient of speech
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) directs the saying toward the wife. This first lam is not the beneficiary or purpose lam later in the ayah; locally it marks the addressee who receives the command.

topics.headline: speech recipient marker
topics.reason: The preposition governs the wife phrase as the addressee complement of the speech verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this first lam directs speech to the wife, unlike the later beneficiary and purpose lams.

words.gloss_range: his wife as a possessive construct phrase, functioning as the addressee of the buyer's speech
words.root_gloss_range: person, man or woman, with wife selected in construct possession; local form foregrounds marital relation
words.prose: {{ar:ٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ}} ({{tr:imraʾatihi}}) is the addressee of the speech, but she is named through relation rather than by a personal name. The possessive suffix binds her to the buyer's household, while the word's personhood range remains beneath the locally selected wife sense.

topics.headline: possessive wife phrase receives the command
topics.reason: The construct noun with possessive suffix is governed by the addressee preposition, selecting wife in this household frame.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the wife as the commanded addressee, named through a possessive household relation.

topics.headline: personhood root background
topics.reason: The broader personhood range can color the phrasing, but the construct possession locally fixes the marital role.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the personhood pressure beneath the locally selected wife role.

words.gloss_range: second-feminine Form IV imperative to actively honor or dignify the assigned lodging
words.root_gloss_range: honor, nobility, generosity, and being precious; Form IV here makes honor something conferred through action
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْرِمِى}} ({{tr:akrimī}}) is a direct feminine singular command. Form IV makes honor an action to be performed, and the object that follows shows that the command works through Yusuf's lodging and treatment, not through an abstract compliment alone. The private order also starts a local honor thread that later returns when women describe Yusuf with honor language (12:31), though the immediate force remains the command to the wife.

topics.headline: wife commanded to confer honor
topics.reason: The command is tagged as a second-feminine Form IV imperative and governs the following lodging noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a direct feminine singular command that makes the wife the executor of Yusuf's changed treatment.

topics.headline: private honoring within a larger honor theme
topics.reason: The root echo and marked command form are useful, but the local prose keeps the immediate transitive command as primary.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the private order to honor Yusuf with the surah's later honor language without letting the echo replace the command.

words.gloss_range: his place of stay or lodging as the direct object of the honor command
words.root_gloss_range: remaining, settling, staying, and a place of abode; local use selects Yusuf's assigned household lodging
words.prose: {{ar:مَثْوَىٰهُ}} ({{tr:mathwāhu}}) is the object being honored: his place of stay. The possessive suffix makes the lodging Yusuf-specific, and the place-noun keeps the command concrete. Its positive household use is striking because the same abode term often carries final-settlement or judgment resonance elsewhere; here that resonance is narrowed into an honored earthly lodging that will be tested in the same house (12:23). The later establishment language can then expand this domestic placement into a wider providential placement.

topics.headline: lodging as object of honor
topics.reason: The noun is a place-of-stay form with a possessive suffix and functions as the object of the command.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the honor is applied concretely to Yusuf's lodging and treatment.

topics.headline: judgment-abode resonance kept secondary
topics.reason: The wider abode distribution may add resonance, but the local construction selects protected household lodging.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses the unusual positive use of an abode term often associated elsewhere with final settlement or judgment.

words.gloss_range: particle-like verb of hope or expectation governing two uncertain alternatives
words.root_gloss_range: hope, expectation, and possibility; here a human hope frame, not divine certainty
words.prose: {{ar:عَسَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ʿasā}}) puts the buyer's reasoning into hope rather than certainty. It scopes over the benefit clause and the adoption alternative, so both are presented as human projections before the divine aside states what is actually being accomplished.

topics.headline: human hope scopes over alternatives
topics.reason: The hope expression governs a dependent clause and extends across the coordinated benefit and adoption options.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees benefit and adoption as two alternatives under one human hope frame.

topics.headline: hope contrasted with divine establishment
topics.reason: The human modal frame is immediately followed by a divine perfect verb of establishment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader contrasts the buyer's uncertainty with the completed divine establishment that follows.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle making the following benefit verb dependent and subjunctive
words.prose: {{ar:أَنْ}} ({{tr:an}}) prevents the benefit clause from standing as a factual assertion. It makes the following verb part of the buyer's hoped-for future, not a result already under his control.

topics.headline: benefit subordinated to hope
topics.reason: The particle governs the following imperfect as a dependent hoped-for clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the benefit clause is dependent hope, not achieved fact.

words.gloss_range: projected practical benefit to the household, marked as uncertain under the hope construction
words.root_gloss_range: benefiting, profiting, being useful, or bringing advantage; locally framed as hoped-for household utility
words.prose: {{ar:يَنفَعَنَآ}} ({{tr:yanfaʿanā}}) is the first possible outcome the buyer imagines. The attached first-plural object makes the household the projected beneficiary, while the subjunctive frame keeps that usefulness uncertain. The divine clause soon shifts the value of Yusuf from benefiting them to being taught by God.

topics.headline: usefulness imagined for us
topics.reason: The verb is subjunctive under the hope construction and carries a first-plural object suffix.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Yusuf measured in human speech by possible usefulness to the household.

topics.headline: human utility answered by divine teaching
topics.reason: The buyer frames Yusuf as useful to the household, while the divine purpose clause makes Yusuf the recipient of teaching.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah shift Yusuf's value from benefiting them to being taught by God.

words.gloss_range: disjunctive connector dividing two human hopes for Yusuf's future role
words.prose: {{ar:أَوْ}} ({{tr:aw}}) marks a fork inside the buyer's plan. Benefit and adoption are alternatives from the human perspective, and the following divine turn shows that neither option exhausts Yusuf's real trajectory.

topics.headline: either-or planning before divine redirection
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates two imagined outcomes under the same hope frame.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human planning offers an either-or fork that divine purpose exceeds.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII subjunctive taking-as construction with Yusuf as object and child as status complement
words.root_gloss_range: taking, seizing, adopting, taking for oneself, or taking as; local construction selects taking him as a child
words.prose: {{ar:نَتَّخِذَهُۥ}} ({{tr:nattakhidhahu}}) is not simple physical taking. With the following status complement, it means taking Yusuf as a child within the household. The Form VIII shape also mirrors the earlier purchase verb, so human acquisition continues from commerce into kinship language.

topics.headline: two-part adoption frame
topics.reason: The verb takes Yusuf as object and the following child noun as a result or status complement.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a taking-as construction that proposes a new household status for Yusuf.

topics.headline: appropriative echo with the purchase verb
topics.reason: The shared Form VIII acquisition pressure is relevant, but the local complement narrows this word to relational adoption.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the adoption verb echo the earlier purchase as another form of human appropriation.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative child or offspring as the proposed status into which Yusuf might be taken
words.root_gloss_range: birth, begetting, offspring, child, and kinship; local use is social adoption, not biological birth
words.prose: {{ar:وَلَدًۭا}} ({{tr:waladan}}) names the proposed status, not the object being taken. Its indefiniteness leaves the role open as a child within the household, and the birth-kinship root is being applied socially rather than biologically. The wider Quranic charge around taking a child, denied of God in theological formulas (23:91; 112:3), remains only contextual here because the local proposal is a human household adoption hope.

topics.headline: indefinite child role
topics.reason: The accusative indefinite noun functions as the result/status complement of the taking-as verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the child word as the proposed status, not the object being taken.

topics.headline: charged offspring field kept contextual
topics.reason: The wider offspring field is important in Quranic usage, but this local phrase is a human household adoption proposal.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retains the wider charged child-language field while keeping the local proposal human and social.

words.gloss_range: transitional connector pivoting from human speech to divine explanatory narration
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) after the quotation is the ayah's major hinge. It does not continue the buyer's words; it resumes narration at a higher level and moves the reader from human hopes to divine action.

topics.headline: shift from speech to divine action
topics.reason: The connector follows the closed quotation and precedes divine first-plural establishment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah turn from human quotation to divine explanation.

words.gloss_range: comparative prefix in the manner-expression linking prior events to divine establishment
words.prose: {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) supplies the comparison in the manner-expression that follows. It helps the ayah say that the sale, purchase, and household entry are not mere background; they are the way the divine establishment is being narrated.

topics.headline: comparison makes prior events the manner
topics.reason: The comparative prefix combines with the demonstrative to form a backward-pointing manner phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the preceding events become the manner of establishment, not mere background.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative gathering the prior event-chain as the manner of divine establishment
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) points back over the chain just narrated. Joined with the comparison prefix, it turns human transaction and hospitality into the manner through which the ayah explains God's establishment of Yusuf. The manner phrase also recalls the earlier promise pattern around Yusuf's selection and teaching (12:6), so the household placement is read as part of that unfolding arc.

topics.headline: prior events gathered for reinterpretation
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative in the manner phrase points back to the preceding transaction and household sequence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the demonstrative gathers sale, purchase, and care into one providential pathway.

topics.headline: echo of earlier manner phrase
topics.reason: The echo is plausible as same-surah structure, but the local demonstrative function is the controlling point.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this manner phrase as a narrowed echo of the earlier promised pattern in Yusuf's story (12:6).

words.gloss_range: divine first-plural Form II perfect of firm establishment and enabling
words.root_gloss_range: firmness, possibility, place, enabling, and establishment; Form II here means causing Yusuf to be firmly established
words.prose: {{ar:مَكَّنَّا}} ({{tr:makkannā}}) relocates agency from the household to God. The divine first-plural perfect presents establishment as the governing completed act, while Form II gives the action firmness: Yusuf is not merely moved into a house but set in place for a larger purpose. This first establishment also anticipates the later public authority formula in the land (12:56), where the seed planted here becomes visible governance.

topics.headline: God as decisive establishing agent
topics.reason: The first-plural perfect shifts the subject of agency from human actors to divine action.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees decisive agency pass from the household to God.

topics.headline: causative firm placement
topics.reason: The Form II shape supports a causative and firm establishment sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that establishment is firm enabling, not mere relocation.

topics.headline: initial establishment anticipates later authority
topics.reason: The same-surah echo helps frame the arc, but this word locally announces the first establishment.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this first establishment as the seed of the later public authority formula (12:56).

words.gloss_range: beneficiary preposition marking Yusuf as the recipient of divine establishment
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) marks Yusuf as beneficiary of establishment. This second lam differs from the earlier addressee lam and from the following purpose lam: here the action is for Yusuf, not merely done to him as an object.

topics.headline: establishment for Yusuf
topics.reason: The preposition mediates the beneficiary of the establishment verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Yusuf as beneficiary of divine establishment, not merely an object moved by others.

topics.headline: addressee to beneficiary to purpose
topics.reason: The ayah uses repeated lam forms with distinct local functions.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah's lam sequence from addressee to beneficiary to purpose.

words.gloss_range: proper named beneficiary of divine establishment, contrasting with earlier pronoun treatment
words.prose: {{ar:يُوسُفَ}} ({{tr:Yūsufa}}) restores the personal name inside the divine aside. Human speech has carried him through suffixes and possible roles, but here he is named as the beneficiary of God's establishment. The marked foreign diptote proper-name form remains secondary, but it reinforces that the divine aside is naming a specific protagonist rather than another household role.

topics.headline: divine aside names Yusuf
topics.reason: The proper name is governed by the beneficiary preposition after the divine establishment verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the divine aside restore Yusuf's name after human speech treats him through suffixes and roles.

topics.headline: proper-name form kept secondary
topics.reason: The form supports named individuality, but the prose does not press broader formal symbolism beyond the local contrast.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the marked proper-name form as secondary support for Yusuf's named individuality.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition placing the establishment within the land as domain
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) supplies the domain of establishment as interior location. Yusuf is established within the land at this point, while the later sovereignty phrase uses a different spatial relation for God's mastery over the affair.

topics.headline: establishment within the land
topics.reason: The preposition completes the establishment frame by introducing the locative domain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Yusuf is established within the land as a domain.

topics.headline: locative relation contrasted with mastery relation
topics.reason: The later preposition in the sovereignty clause has a different relation, supporting the contrast between placement and dominance.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes placement within the land from God's mastery over the affair.

words.gloss_range: the land as a definite territorial domain, wider than the earlier Egyptian provenance
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, land, territory, and domain; local use is the arena of Yusuf's establishment
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) widens the scale beyond the named Egyptian source. The phrase keeps a concrete territorial sense while making the domain broader than the buyer's household or city: Yusuf is being established in the land. The wording also fits a broader establishment-in-the-land pattern for enabled authority, while the local contrast with the brothers' attempted removal from the land (12:9) keeps the payoff inside Yusuf's story.

topics.headline: land wider than local provenance
topics.reason: The definite land noun follows the establishment verb and contrasts with the earlier proper place source.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the scale widen from Egypt and household to the land.

topics.headline: recognized establishment domain
topics.reason: The establishment-and-land pairing is relevant, but the local phrase is enough to anchor the domain without expanding into a full type-scene.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader places Yusuf's land-establishment inside a broader Quranic pattern of enabled authority.

words.gloss_range: conjunctive link joining teaching purpose to divine establishment
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps establishment and teaching together. The next purpose clause is not an unrelated addition; it explains what the placement is for.

topics.headline: establishment joined to teaching
topics.reason: The conjunction links the divine establishment clause to the teaching purpose clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps establishment and teaching as coordinated parts of one design.

words.gloss_range: purpose preposition introducing the divine aim of teaching Yusuf
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) now functions as purpose. After the addressee lam and the beneficiary lam, this third use gives the reason for establishment: in order to teach him.

topics.headline: purpose relation for teaching
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following subjunctive teaching verb as a purpose clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees teaching named as the purpose of establishment.

topics.headline: third lam completes relation shift
topics.reason: The repeated lam forms move from human addressee to divine beneficiary to divine purpose.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated lam sound marking three different relations in the ayah.

words.gloss_range: divine first-plural Form II subjunctive teaching with Yusuf as attached object
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, knowledge, teaching, marking, and making known; Form II here is structured divine instruction
words.prose: {{ar:نُعَلِّمَهُۥ}} ({{tr:nuʿallimahu}}) states the purpose of the establishment. The prefix marks divine agency and the suffix makes Yusuf the direct recipient of teaching, reversing his earlier objecthood under commerce into the object of divine instruction. Form II makes that instruction structured and causative rather than a casual disclosure, and the same knowledge root later closes the ayah on the majority who do not know.

topics.headline: God teaches Yusuf
topics.reason: The purpose lam governs a first-plural Form II teaching verb with Yusuf as attached object.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Yusuf's earlier objecthood transformed into direct reception of divine instruction.

topics.headline: causative structured instruction
topics.reason: The Form II morphology supports causing to know through instruction rather than bare awareness.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the teaching is structured and causative, not a casual disclosure.

topics.headline: teaching contrasted with majority non-knowing
topics.reason: The same root appears again in the final non-knowing clause, creating an internal contrast.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees divine teaching of Yusuf set against the majority's non-knowing at the close.

words.gloss_range: partitive or domain-marking preposition limiting the field of taught interpretation
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) frames the content of the teaching as from a domain, not as unlimited omniscience. It can be read as partitive or domain-marking, and in either case it keeps the knowledge measured and specified.

topics.headline: from the interpretive field
topics.reason: The preposition introduces the domain or share of interpretation taught to Yusuf.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the taught knowledge is from a specified interpretive field, not an unlimited claim.

words.gloss_range: construct verbal noun for interpretation, returning accounts or events to their underlying outcome
words.root_gloss_range: returning, going back to origin or outcome, interpreting, and realizing; local noun carries both interpretive act and eventual fulfillment
words.prose: {{ar:تَأْوِيلِ}} ({{tr:taʾwīli}}) is the content-load of the purpose clause. As a construct verbal noun, it binds interpretation to the accounts that follow. The root's return-to-outcome pressure lets the word cover both the act of interpreting and the realized end to which events point. It is also a Yusuf motif running from the earlier promise (12:6) through later fulfillment and prayer (12:100; 12:101), but that motif supports rather than replaces the local purpose clause.

topics.headline: interpretation as process and realization
topics.reason: The root and local construct phrase support interpretation that returns accounts to their underlying outcome.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees interpretation as both reading an account and reaching the outcome it points toward.

topics.headline: systematic interpretive practice
topics.reason: The gerund in construct position makes interpretation a named field rather than a loose abstract ability.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices interpretation as an ongoing discipline or craft taught to Yusuf.

topics.headline: motif across the Yusuf narrative
topics.reason: The recurring motif is relevant, but this layer keeps the local phrase as the source for the later arc.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this word to the Yusuf motif that runs from promise to fulfillment (12:6; 12:100; 12:101).

words.gloss_range: definite plural accounts, reports, or events as the object-domain of interpretation
words.root_gloss_range: occurring, being new, reporting, narrating, and accounts; local plural means accounts or events needing interpretation, not the later technical genre
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ}} ({{tr:al-aḥādīthi}}) completes the phrase by naming the field that interpretation applies to. The definite broken plural gathers multiple reports or events under one recognized domain, and it should not be narrowed to a later technical label. Because the surah later describes the story itself as a meaningful account (12:111), this word also makes Yusuf's interpretive skill part of the surah's own narrative self-awareness.

topics.headline: definite plural field of accounts
topics.reason: The definite plural is the genitive complement of the interpretation noun and specifies its domain.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the object of interpretation as a definite field of accounts and events, not a later technical label.

topics.headline: narrative self-reference kept secondary
topics.reason: The broader narrative echo is useful, but the local job of the word is to complete the taught interpretive field.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the surah about interpreting accounts also frame itself as a meaningful account (12:111).

words.gloss_range: connector introducing a general theological assertion after the purpose clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) moves from Yusuf's specific teaching purpose into a broader closing assertion. It links the narrated placement to the general truth that follows, rather than adding another item to the teaching content.

topics.headline: specific purpose linked to general maxim
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces a new theological clause after the teaching purpose is complete.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the move from Yusuf's specific purpose into a general theological maxim.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as explicit subject of the sovereignty clause
words.root_gloss_range: divinity, worship, devotion, and Godhood; local use is the proper divine name grounding the predicate of prevailing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) is the explicit subject of the closing sovereignty clause. The wording does not leave the outcome to fate or narrative chance; it names God before stating the attribute of prevailing. Derivational associations with worship and overwhelming bewilderment remain background only, but they suit a clause where God's mastery is clear while most people do not know it.

topics.headline: God named as subject of prevailing
topics.reason: The proper divine name is the nominative subject of the nominal sentence.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sovereignty clause anchored in God, not impersonal fate.

topics.headline: derivational associations not made primary
topics.reason: The name's wider derivational discussion may color the clause, but the local syntax uses the proper divine name as subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader retains worship and bewilderment associations as background to the divine name in a non-knowledge clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite active participle predicate: prevailing, dominant, not merely winning once
words.root_gloss_range: overcoming, defeating, prevailing, and being dominant; local active participle states God's durable mastery over the affair
words.prose: {{ar:غَالِبٌ}} ({{tr:ghālibun}}) is the predicate that completes the divine-name clause. Its active participle form presents prevailing as an abiding attribute, and the following prepositional phrase specifies the domain over which that dominance applies. The wording also casts the human schemes of Surah 12, including the brothers' and household plots, under God's prevailing rather than letting any scheme appear final.

topics.headline: active participle of prevailing
topics.reason: The active participle functions as an indefinite predicate in a nominal sentence about God.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees prevailing stated as an abiding divine attribute, not a one-time win.

topics.headline: prevailing over the affair
topics.reason: The participle is completed by the following over-relation and affair noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine dominance is specified over an affair or command.

topics.headline: dominance over human schemes
topics.reason: The broader narrative contrast is appropriate background, but the local clause itself states divine prevailing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader reads human schemes in Surah 12 under the stated dominance of God.

words.gloss_range: preposition of overness marking mastery over the affair
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) completes the prevailing predicate with an over-relation. The ayah had placed Yusuf within the land; here it places God's mastery over the affair, changing spatial language into hierarchy.

topics.headline: over-relation after prevailing
topics.reason: The preposition complements the active participle and marks the relation of dominance over the following noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the preposition turn prevailing into mastery over the affair.

topics.headline: within placement versus over mastery
topics.reason: The contrast with the earlier locative preposition is locally visible in the same ayah.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader contrasts Yusuf's within-placement with God's over-mastery.

words.gloss_range: possessed affair or command/decree as the domain of God's prevailing, with pronoun reference intentionally open
words.root_gloss_range: commanding, ordering, decree, matter, affair, and eventive concern; local phrase allows command/decree and Yusuf's affair to interact
words.prose: {{ar:أَمْرِهِۦ}} ({{tr:amrihi}}) is the domain over which God prevails. The word can carry command or affair, and the attached pronoun is the crux: it can point toward God's decree or toward Yusuf's unfolding matter. The local clause benefits from that overlap rather than forcing only one side.

topics.headline: command and affair both active
topics.reason: The root range and local sovereignty phrase support both decree and matter as interacting senses.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps both command/decree and Yusuf's affair active in the sovereignty claim.

topics.headline: possessive pronoun remains interpretively open
topics.reason: The suffix is grammatically attached and can be read with divine decree or Yusuf's affair; the output preserves this local ambiguity.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the suffix can point toward God's command or Yusuf's affair without forcing a premature choice.

topics.headline: eventive command or affair
topics.reason: The gerund form keeps the noun eventive rather than a static abstract label.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the affair as an eventive command or decreeing in motion.

words.gloss_range: connector carrying the sovereignty assertion into the contrastive close
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the sovereignty statement and the human ignorance statement in one closing unit. It prepares the contrastive particle rather than simply adding a separate fact.

topics.headline: connector into contrast
topics.reason: The conjunction directly precedes the adversative particle and links the two closing clauses.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps divine sovereignty and human ignorance joined in one closing unit.

words.gloss_range: adversative annulling particle contrasting divine prevailing with majority non-knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:لَٰكِنَّ}} ({{tr:lākinna}}) does not weaken the claim that God prevails. It turns from that truth to the human failure to know it, while its annulling grammar pulls the following majority term into the governed contrast.

topics.headline: contrast between truth and perception
topics.reason: The particle introduces the final clause contrasting divine sovereignty with human non-knowledge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the contrast move from what is true of God to what most humans fail to know.

topics.headline: governs the majority term
topics.reason: The particle governs the following comparative noun as its accusative subject.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the particle grammatically governs the majority term in the contrast.

words.gloss_range: comparative majority term, governed by the adversative particle and scoped by the people phrase
words.root_gloss_range: many, much, increase, abundance, and majority; local comparative means most, not all
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْثَرَ}} ({{tr:akthara}}) makes the final ignorance claim majority-based rather than total. Governed by the contrastive particle and bound to the following people term, it leaves room for exceptions such as those whom God teaches. The same majority-ignorance refrain recurs after divine disclosure in Surah 12 (12:40; 12:68), so this is not a loose complaint about many people but a repeated theological closure.

topics.headline: most, not all
topics.reason: The comparative in construct with the people term creates a majority claim, not an absolute universal.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ignorance claim as most, not all, leaving room for taught exceptions.

topics.headline: accusative subject under the adversative particle
topics.reason: The comparative is governed by the adversative particle and made definite in scope by the following genitive.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the majority term is grammatically drawn under the adversative particle.

topics.headline: majority-ignorance refrain
topics.reason: The recurring formula is useful, but the local semantic payoff is the restricted majority claim.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a Surah 12 refrain about majority failure after divine disclosure (12:40; 12:68).

words.gloss_range: definite human class from which the majority is selected
words.root_gloss_range: people, humankind, sociability, familiarity, and being perceived; local noun means people as a class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) supplies the class for the majority claim. The final line is no longer only about the Egyptian household; it generalizes to people as a known human class whose majority does not know the divine pattern. The root background sharpens the irony: social, perceptive humans are the ones described as not knowing. The people term also joins Surah 12's public-response pattern, where people receive favor yet often fail to receive or recognize it (12:38; 12:103).

topics.headline: people as the class in view
topics.reason: The definite genitive noun specifies the class from which the majority is selected.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final claim generalize from the Egyptian household to people as a class.

topics.headline: social-perceptive root irony
topics.reason: The root discussion can sharpen the irony, but the local noun functions first as the human class in the majority phrase.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader catches the irony that social, perceptive humans are described as not knowing the divine pattern.

topics.headline: people term in wider response pattern
topics.reason: The same-surah response pattern is relevant but secondary to the local genitive role.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the people term to the surah's wider public-response pattern (12:38; 12:103).

words.gloss_range: negator of the imperfect knowing verb, making non-knowing an ongoing state
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) negates the knowing verb that closes the ayah. Because it negates an imperfect verb, the result is not a single past failure but an ongoing state of not knowing.

topics.headline: negation of imperfect knowing
topics.reason: The negator scopes over the following imperfect verb, producing a continuing non-knowledge claim.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees non-knowing as an ongoing state, not a single past lapse.

topics.headline: negative content for the contrast
topics.reason: The negation supplies the predicate content required by the contrastive final clause.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the negator supply the final negative content required by the contrast.

words.gloss_range: imperfect plural knowing verb negated to describe ongoing majority non-knowledge of divine providence
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, knowledge, teaching, marking, and making known; local Form I is basic knowing, negated for most people
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) leaves the ayah on non-knowledge. The unstated object is supplied by the preceding divine disclosure: most people do not know how God's establishment, purpose, and prevailing command are working through the events they see. The same knowledge root has just named God's teaching of Yusuf, so the final verb makes the contrast explicit: Yusuf is taught while the majority remains in ordinary non-knowing.

topics.headline: imperfect plural under negation
topics.reason: The imperfect plural verb agrees with the majority sense and is negated as an ongoing condition.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah end on continuing majority non-knowledge.

topics.headline: what they do not know is the divine pattern
topics.reason: The immediately preceding divine aside supplies the object of the non-knowledge claim.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader knows that what most people fail to know is the divine establishment, purpose, and prevailing command just disclosed.

topics.headline: same knowledge root contrasts Yusuf and most people
topics.reason: The ayah earlier used the same root for divine teaching of Yusuf, while this final verb marks most people's lack of knowing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same knowledge root divide Yusuf's taught status from ordinary human non-knowing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ishtarahu ... akrimi mathwahu ... yanfa'ana aw nattakhidhahu waladan
baseline_models.mechanism: A purchased person is rerouted from priced possession into two household futures, useful benefit or deliberately constructed sonship. Honoring his residence interrupts pure commodity treatment without erasing acquisition.

activation_trace.role: Priced exchange supplies the ownership relation that the household proposals modify but do not erase.
Bestowed honor changes the expected treatment of the acquired person from bare possession to dignified care.
Benefit opposed to harm keeps an instrumental household future explicitly alive.
Deliberate acquisition makes sonship a social act to be undertaken rather than a biological fact.
The offspring branch supplies the kin category toward which the acquired stranger may be transferred.

changed_reading.before: A buyer tells his wife to treat a promising purchased youth well.
changed_reading.after: The speech stages an unstable conversion from commodity to honored resident, useful dependent, or constructed son, preserving care and possession together.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: akrimi mathwahu ... wa-kadhalika makkanna li-Yusufa fi al-ard
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse scales from a prepared household residence to land-wide placement and capacity. The local act of hosting is the near spatial form through which divine emplacement becomes materially operative.

activation_trace.role: Generous honor gives the local residence a positive social quality rather than mere containment.
The residence-and-guest branch supplies the household scale of emplacement.
A place of being expands the prepared lodging into a durable position in the land.
Capacity and empowerment prevent placement from meaning location alone; the position carries future agency.
The ground below supplies the wider territorial scale on which household placement is amplified.

changed_reading.before: Kind lodging is followed by a separate statement that God established Joseph in Egypt.
changed_reading.after: The honored lodging is a small-scale emplacement nested inside God's wider placing and empowering of Joseph in the land.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: wa-li-nu'allimahu min ta'wili al-ahadith ... la ya'lamun
baseline_models.mechanism: Teaching joins disclosure, the return of a thing to its outcome, renewed speech, and occurring events. Ta'wil is therefore temporal and causal literacy, not only lexical decoding.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower links Joseph's taught knowledge with the majority's paired failure to perceive.
Return to an end or outcome makes interpretation a movement from present sign toward eventual consequence.
Renewed speech and news supply the verbal material whose implications can be traced.
An occurring event or adverse turn expands ahadith from reports to lived happenings with developing outcomes.

changed_reading.before: Ta'wil al-ahadith names a skill for interpreting reports or dreams.
changed_reading.after: It names the ability to return fresh speech and unfolding events to the ends they are moving toward, against general unawareness.

baseline_models.mechanism: The buyer speaks, acquires, and projects a household role, yet effective governance of the affair belongs elsewhere. Divine prevalence is a jurisdictional reversal working through local human decisions.

activation_trace.role: The image of a speaker whose word carries force foregrounds the buyer's apparent local say.
Acquisition supplies a human attempt to assign Joseph a durable household identity.
Divinely granted capacity identifies the effective result hidden inside the buyer's plan.
Overpowering force assigns final efficacy to God rather than to the visible household actor.
The affair as an unfolding state supplies the domain over which competing plans operate.
The authority branch lets the affair also register as governance, sharpening the jurisdictional contrast.

changed_reading.before: The clause gives a general assurance that God controls events.
changed_reading.after: It reverses visible jurisdiction: human speech and acquisition supply the route, but God's governance determines what that route accomplishes.

context_deltas.mechanism: Concealment converts Joseph into trade stock and the sale strips his price below due worth; the next command to honor his residence becomes an abrupt revaluation. The verse does not simply reward an expensive acquisition but interrupts a chain of hidden commodification.

activation_trace.role: The focus exchange branch receives the preceding sale and carries its ownership relation into the house.
Honor supplies the upward value correction that contests the preceding treatment.
Concealment in the interior removes Joseph from open personhood and enables his recoding as stock.
A portion of capital made merchandise gives the concealment its commercial function.
Sale value supplies the metric by which Joseph has just been assessed.
Depletion of due worth makes the low valuation ethically and not merely numerically deficient.

structural_cues: 12:19 hides Joseph as merchandise, 12:20 prices him deficiently, and 12:21 immediately commands honorable residence.
The same exchange root spans the sale in 12:20 and the purchase recalled in 12:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, merchandise, deficient price, then honor; I infer a deliberate value reversal across the sequence. A live alternative is that unrelated sellers and buyer simply make different practical estimates.

changed_reading.before: The buyer adds humane treatment to an ordinary purchase.
changed_reading.after: Honor functions as a counter-valuation of someone just hidden, merchandised, and sold below his due worth, while the purchase relation remains unresolved.

context_deltas.mechanism: A moving group and a tool lowered from above initiate the chain that ends in stable residence and capacity. The downward instrument produces Joseph's upward social transfer, so divine emplacement works through an inversion of motion.

activation_trace.role: The traveling group supplies horizontal displacement and the mobile carrier of Joseph's transition.
Descent from above gives the retrieval instrument a downward motion whose effect on Joseph is inverse.
Prepared lodging arrests the travel sequence at a household station.
Capacity turns the endpoint of movement into social and future agency.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from caravan motion, through the lowering of a bucket and commercial transfer, to residence and emplacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a moving group, downward bucket action, and later stable placement; I supply the inverse arrow that lowering the instrument enables Joseph's ascent. Alternatively, the bucket is only a discovery device with no thematic inversion.

changed_reading.before: Joseph is transported and then happens to receive a stable home.
changed_reading.after: The emplacement is the inverted outcome of prior motion: a lowered means lifts him into a durable position, making descent itself an instrument of placement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph later repeats the residence term while invoking goodness received from his rabb inside the same house. The focus command thus becomes an obligation-laden hospitality that grounds refusal, while locked doors expose how a residence can invert from refuge into coercive enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The command of honorable generosity supplies the norm later invoked under pressure.
The guest-residence branch identifies the benefit as a socially prepared place, not abstract favor.
The marital household locates both the received lodging and the later demand inside one domestic institution.
Coercive closure turns the protective boundary of the house into pressure against its resident.
Nurture and completion make the rabb relation a possible source of the goodness Joseph acknowledges.
An enacted good recasts honorable lodging as a received deed that calls for an ethical response.
The exact residence image recalls the focus command and makes the later refusal answer it.

structural_cues: The focus command akrimi mathwahu is answered in 12:23 by ahsana mathwaya.
The repeated residence stands inside a house whose doors have just been tightly closed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical echo, household, goodness, and closure; I infer that Joseph treats received lodging as a norm against betrayal. The live alternative is that rabbi refers only to God, shifting the covenant's source from the buyer to divine nurture.

changed_reading.before: The buyer requests comfortable accommodation for Joseph.
changed_reading.after: The accommodation becomes an ethical covenant Joseph invokes, even as the same domestic space reveals its capacity to entrap and coerce.

context_deltas.mechanism: The buyer's hoped benefit and the divine teaching purpose unfold through a marked interval: reaching full strength, then receiving judgment and knowledge as recompense for enacted good. Utility is displaced from immediate labor value toward mature ethical and interpretive capacity.

activation_trace.role: Benefit supplies the buyer's open-ended projection whose content the next verse revises.
Disclosure through teaching supplies the stated divine developmental end.
Arrival at a limit establishes maturation as a temporal threshold rather than an immediate consequence.
Attainment of full strength specifies the threshold at which latent household potential becomes manifest.
Bestowal identifies judgment and knowledge as granted capacities rather than extracted usefulness.
Sound judgment gives mature benefit an ethical-intellectual form.
Manifest knowledge explicitly realizes the teaching purpose announced in the focus.
Reciprocal recompense supplies an ethical rather than commercial economy for the resulting capacities.
Enacted good names the conduct to which the mature gift is linked.

structural_cues: 12:22 begins with a maturation threshold and repeats wa-kadhalika before judgment, knowledge, and recompense.
The focus purpose li-nu'allimahu is followed immediately by explicit knowledge granted after maturation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hoped benefit, a teaching purpose, maturation, gifts, and recompense; I infer a developmental realization rather than immediate utility. Alternatively, the gifts answer Joseph's ihsan independently of any benefit from household nurture.

changed_reading.before: The buyer hopes Joseph may become useful, while God independently intends to teach him.
changed_reading.after: The hope is delayed and transformed: Joseph matures into judgment and knowledge under an ethical economy, not into immediate labor value.

context_deltas.mechanism: A witness converts a cut garment and its front-or-back orientation into a rule for reconstructing an unseen event. This material inference activates ta'wil as returning a present mark to the event and truth-condition that produced it.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides supplies a sign-based mode of knowing.
Return to outcome supplies the backward inference from surviving evidence to what occurred.
Making a thing manifest gives the reconstructed event an evidentiary endpoint.
A witnessing sign supplies the explicit bridge from material trace to adjudicative claim.
The worn garment provides the material carrier on which the event leaves its mark.
A longitudinal cut supplies the observable alteration requiring causal explanation.
Front-facing orientation supplies one conditional causal direction.
The back of the object supplies the competing direction that reverses the verdict.

structural_cues: 12:26 and 12:27 present paired if-then rules keyed to the same garment's front or back.
12:28 then reports visual inspection of the marked garment before judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a material mark, conditional direction rules, inspection, and verdict; I infer that this scene structurally instantiates the focus's interpretive capacity. A live alternative is that it models the skill around Joseph without attributing this inference to him.

changed_reading.before: Ta'wil concerns verbal reports or future dreams.
changed_reading.after: Ta'wil also becomes forensic return: reading a present material sign backward into the hidden event and forward into a warranted verdict.

context_deltas.mechanism: A group turns the household event into city speech; the subject hears its spread and stages a response that generates further speech. Ahadith now includes reputational narratives whose circulation changes the actions they describe.

activation_trace.role: Speech circulating among people supplies a latent social scale beyond the buyer's private utterance.
Becoming the talk of people turns a person and event into a reputational narrative.
The women's utterance realizes the focus branch as speech spreading beyond the house.
A collective of women supplies the social relay through which the private event becomes public judgment.
The gathered city supplies the wider field in which household speech acquires reputation.
Public renown reaching the ear closes the causal loop from gossip to staged response.

structural_cues: Speech in 12:30 is heard in 12:31 and directly causes a social performance that produces new speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies city talk, hearing, response, and renewed talk; I infer a self-altering narrative circuit that ta'wil must read. Alternatively, ahadith in 12:21 remains restricted to reports or dreams, and this circuit is only an analogy.

changed_reading.before: Joseph will interpret discrete reports presented to him.
changed_reading.after: He is being placed inside narrative systems where circulating reports alter conduct and manufacture the next report, making interpretation socially causal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus treats honor as an act the wife should confer; the later spectators see Joseph, magnify him, and speak of a noble angel. The recurrence permits honor to be read also as recognition of perceived excellence, not only externally granted treatment.

activation_trace.role: Honor and noble excellence hold together the action of honoring and the quality later perceived.
Direct seeing supplies the perceptual event that triggers the spectators' revaluation.
Magnification within the breast supplies the spectators' elevation of what they see.
The angel category supplies the hyperbolic vehicle through which human status is exceeded.
Noble excellence repeats the focus root and makes the earlier imperative sound proleptically recognitive.

structural_cues: The same honor root occurs first as an imperative about Joseph's treatment and later inside the spectators' description prompted by seeing him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root recurrence and a perceptual revaluation; I infer that the imperative can anticipate recognition of worth. Alternatively, karim grammatically modifies the imagined angel only and attributes no intrinsic status to Joseph.

changed_reading.before: The wife is asked to confer honorable treatment on a purchased dependent.
changed_reading.after: The command can also anticipate recognition of a worth spectators later hyperbolically perceive, without settling whether that perception is reliable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The possible son of 12:21 is later socially named as her fata, made the object of solicitation, commanded, and threatened with abasement. The kinship conversion remains an unrealized possibility; acquisition persists beneath domestic inclusion.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate acquisition supplies the proposed social conversion and its continuing possessive underside.
Sonship supplies the elevated family status projected but never confirmed in the window.
The young-man term's use for an owned dependent supplies a lower household status that competes with projected sonship.
Persistent solicitation turns domestic access into pressure on the dependent's agency.
Love reaching the heart supplies the affective force that destabilizes the proposed family relation.
Threatened humiliation exposes the hierarchy still available inside the supposedly protective household.

structural_cues: The focus offers sonship only as one possible future, while 12:30 calls Joseph her fata and 12:32 threatens him with prison and abasement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies projected sonship, a dependent-status term, solicitation, and threatened humiliation; I infer that kin incorporation did not stabilize. A live alternative is that fata means only young man or attendant and that no completed adoption was ever claimed.

changed_reading.before: The household opens a credible path from purchase into family membership.
changed_reading.after: Sonship remains a suspended projection; later language and coercion reveal that domestic inclusion can preserve rather than dissolve dependency.

context_deltas.mechanism: The woman's explicit command claims Joseph's action and backs that claim with prison and humiliation; his self-restraint refuses it. God's prevalence over the affair is thereby activated as a conflict of jurisdictions, not an abstract maxim.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing force assigns final efficacy to God within the coming struggle over Joseph's action.
The unfolding affair supplies the shared field on which visible command and hidden outcome diverge.
Protective self-restraint supplies Joseph's active refusal of household control.
An enforcing command gives the competing human jurisdiction an explicit verbal form.
Confinement supplies the coercive sanction intended to make the command effective.
Abasement supplies the social sanction accompanying bodily confinement.

structural_cues: 12:32 places ista'sama, ma amuruhu, prison, and abasement in one conditional threat.
The focus's amrihi is later answered by a human first-person command from inside the household that acquired Joseph.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine prevalence, a human command, refusal, and sanctions; I infer rival jurisdictions and that coercion cannot finally own Joseph's trajectory. Alternatively, amrihi refers only to God's decree, with no deliberate lexical contest.

changed_reading.before: God's control guarantees the plan despite unspecified human activity.
changed_reading.after: The clause anticipates an explicit contest over who can command Joseph; even successful human confinement does not equal control of the affair's outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Joseph prefers prison, divine action turns the pressure away, and the household nevertheless confines him after seeing signs, but only until a time. Emplacement is therefore non-linear: a bounded residence can become an intermediate station within eventual empowerment.

activation_trace.role: Stable or prolonged residence supplies a category broad enough to become involuntary lodging.
Empowerment supplies the eventual capacity that prevents confinement from being the final meaning of placement.
Return to outcome requires the bounded interval to be read by what it eventually enables, not by appearance alone.
Prison as a containing place becomes Joseph's preferred boundary against the immediate demand.
Turning from one state to another supplies divine redirection within, rather than simple removal from, the sequence.
Visible signs make the later confinement knowingly chosen rather than evidentially necessary.
Actual confinement realizes the threatened residence despite the signs.
Residence for an interval gives the confinement a bounded temporal horizon.

structural_cues: 12:33 prefers prison to compliance, 12:34 records divine redirection, and 12:35 imposes prison after signs but marks it as lasting only until a time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen refuge, divine redirection, unjust confinement, and a time limit; I infer that prison becomes protected transit within emplacement. The live alternative is that confinement is only injustice endured before an unrelated later empowerment.

changed_reading.before: Divine emplacement means movement into increasing security and freedom.
changed_reading.after: Emplacement can proceed through a timed enclosure that protects one agency while restricting another, so present confinement and eventual empowerment coexist.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports milk-return, generation, egg, and growth images into a social-political statement. It remains anchored in the supplied branches for 'asa, walad, makkanna, and the next verse's maturation; downstream prose should label incubation as a cross-domain metaphor, never as the lexical denotation of tamkin.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: 'asa an yanfa'ana aw nattakhidhahu waladan ... makkanna

activation_trace.role: Hope for returning yield gives 'asa a latent-productivity image rather than bare uncertainty.
Something generated from another turns projected sonship into a broader image of emergent capacity.
Eggs enclosed in a body supply the strange but coherent image of protected potential developing inside placement.
Reaching a limit supplies the later maturation that tests the incubation image.
Emergent growth and yield supply the realized capacities that come out of the protected interval.

changed_reading.before: The buyer hopes for practical benefit or adoption, and God grants position.
changed_reading.after: The household placement can be carried as an incubatory interval in which hidden potential matures into judgment and knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it follows the packet's non-dominant mapping of QAC hamza-waw-lam into waw-lam-ya and therefore exceeds the usual return-to-outcome sense. The split inventory is packet-authorized and coheres with command and judgment; downstream prose must present stewardship as a secondary activation alongside, not instead of, interpretation.

activation_trace.role: Unbroken succession turns ahadith into sequences whose relations must be tracked.
Taking charge of an affair supplies stewardship as an active dimension of learned ta'wil.
Gaining mastery and reaching a limit joins stewardship to successful arrival at an outcome.
Deliberation and management give the surrounding affair a practical governance dimension.
Well-formed, reliable judgment supplies the capacity by which interpretive stewardship could operate.

changed_reading.before: Joseph is taught to decode the meanings and outcomes of reports.
changed_reading.after: Joseph is also formed to take charge of connected event-sequences, making ta'wil an exploratory mode of stewardship over unfolding affairs.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the proper name Misr through a boundary branch and joins it to the land's stranger branch. The spatial chain remains anchored in Misr, land, movement, and emplacement; downstream prose should mark it as paronomastic spatial activation, not as a historical etymology of Egypt.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: min Misra ... makkanna li-Yusufa fi al-ard

activation_trace.role: A boundary or barrier turns the named territory into a field with an inside and outside.
The land's stranger supplies Joseph's displaced social relation to the territory.
A place of being supplies the conversion from outsider movement to an assigned position.
Displacement and removal supply the motion by which the stranger crosses into the bounded field.
A dwelling supplies the first interior position granted to the territorial outsider.

changed_reading.before: An Egyptian buyer brings Joseph into a house and God establishes him in Egypt.
changed_reading.after: A displaced stranger crosses a bounded social field and receives an interior position from which his relation to the whole land can be reorganized.

strongest_changes: The hidden, underpriced commodity becomes an honored resident and possible son, a revaluation that does not erase possession.
The exact residence echo and later locked house turn hospitality into an ethical covenant exposed to coercion.
The marked garment and the city speech circuit expand ta'wil into forensic and social reading of events as well as reports.
Human command, prison, and abasement turn God's prevailing affair into a contest of jurisdictions and make emplacement non-linear.
summary.what_was_special: The focus holds incompatible statuses at once: commodity, guest, useful dependent, possible son, territorial stranger, learner, and future empowered agent. Context activates rather than resolves those tensions, while the split ta'wil mapping preserves an exploratory stewardship reading beside return-to-outcome.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether household honor causally contributes to maturation or merely coincides with an independently divine gift.
Whether rabbi in 12:23 points to the human master, God, or deliberately sustains both relations.
Whether amrihi in 12:21 invites a lexical contest with the woman's command or refers only to God's decree.
How far al-ahadith should include material and social events rather than reports and dreams.
Whether fataha encodes owned dependency here or only youth and household service.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Purchased status is redirected into settled formation.** ث و ي B001/B002 (staying/lodging and household relation), ك ر م B001 (honoring), and م ك ن B005 (enablement) turn the sale into a durable place of development. I infer that hospitable settlement enables capacities that forced transport could not erase. `أكرمي مثواه` reads as an unwitting contribution to empowerment.
2. **Human intention is nested inside overpowering governance.** The buyer proposes ن ف ع B001 and و ل د B001, while غ ل ب B001 (overpowering force) qualifies God’s `أمر`. I infer that local motives remain real but are subordinated to a wider event-direction. The ayah preserves adoption, utility, education, and divine governance as distinct causal layers.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:56 explicitly repeated تمكين in the land, and 12:100 disclosed that the wider امر had been carrying the household toward reunion.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Lodging as an ethical household relation.** `ث و ي:B002` is “the lodging-place, household, and guest relation,” including host, guest, and causing someone to lodge; `ث و ي:B001` also includes constrained residence. The buyer orders an honored lodging, but 12:23 locates solicitation in “her house,” 12:25 brings the household master to the door, and 12:26 invokes a witness from her people. The packet supplies the household roles; I infer that hospitality creates a duty later violated inside its own space. *Akrimī mathwāhu* therefore reads as the ethical baseline against which the house episode is judged.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 12:99 repeats sheltering at the scale of Joseph's parents and then all Egypt, fulfilling the ethical possibility latent here: lodging becomes secure relation rather than possession of a useful stranger.

baseline.text: Onu Mısır'da satın alan adam karısına, "Ona güzel bir yer ver. Belki bize yararı dokunur ya da onu evlat ediniriz" dedi. Böylece Yusuf'u o ülkede yerleştirdik ve ona sözlerin yorumundan öğretelim diye bunu yaptık. Allah işinde üstündür, fakat insanların çoğu bilmez.

findings.text: Onurlu konaklama, zorla taşınmış Yusuf'a kalıcı gelişme alanı açarken ev halkı için sonradan ihlal edilecek bir misafirlik yükümlülüğü de kurar.
Alıcının yarar ve evlatlık düşüncesi gerçek bir yerel amaç olarak kalır, fakat daha geniş olay akışı bu amacı aşan bir yönetimin içine yerleşir.

inter_ayah_rows.note: Direct sequel: Yusuf's later settled authority develops the placement opened here.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Frames benefit as outcome-bearing, while leaving the buyer's local purpose distinct.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Adds a separate register of honor as consequential reception rather than display.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Close narrative parallel: a transferred child is received for benefit or possible child-status.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Immediate prehistory of Yusuf's reduction to a tradable object before reclassification.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Keeps dominance contingent, supporting f02 without collapsing it into the buyer's aim.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Earlier promise supplies the instructional horizon later stated at 12:21.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Shows the household setting later turning coercive, sharpening f01's vulnerable hospitality.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mixed f02 resonance on constructive and destructive force, but no close narrative link.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Later fulfillment reads the displacement and release as part of a subtle ordered course.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A contrary lodging image makes residence capable of becoming fixed and inescapable.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Repeats the prior contrary lodging pattern without adding a new focus-specific angle.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Later narrative reiterates taught knowledge and widespread non-knowing under divine governance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Immediate sale scene fixes the low commodity classification that 12:21 reverses.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Qualifies f02: child and kinship ties do not guarantee ultimate benefit.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Offers protected growth toward maturity and later disclosure as a parallel developmental frame.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Directly supplies the decision that makes Yusuf's transfer and purchase possible.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Another contrary residence image, already substantially covered by earlier lodging cards.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Later episode shows Yusuf acting within, yet not exhausted by, an overriding arrangement.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Power and faculties remain granted capacities, not guarantees of rightly used understanding.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Develops empowerment as furnished means rather than self-originating possession.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Theological rejection of divine child-status only distantly bounds the local adoption proposal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Prison continuation makes the promised teaching of interpretation concrete in Yusuf's trajectory.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Reiterates a distant theological contrast to child-status after a stronger local parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Yusuf's final retrospective joins granted authority with taught interpretation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The guest-lodging channel route is too indirect to clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Presents gained power as ordered judgment, a broad but secondary f01 resonance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Purchase and benefit language occur in a remote, mixed ethical setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rescue of the oppressed is a distant transfer pattern, not a close reading of 12:21.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Honor and abasement provide only a broad value contrast to f01.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Benefit and harm form a remote contrast without advancing the Yusuf scene.

root_profile.summary: Kök, azlık; bir şeyin tepesi veya başı; büyük bir kap; yük taşıma, yükselme ve yola koyulma; korku ya da öfkeden titreme; nesnenin oynayıp yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesi olmak üzere altı ayrı anlam kolunda düzenlenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bedel karşılığında bir şeyi hem edinme hem de elden çıkarma yönlerini açıkça bildirir. Bu nedenle dal, alış ve satışın karşılıklı değişim içindeki iki yönünü birlikte kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın kullanımdır; tanım herhangi bir özel tamlamaya bağlı olmadan bedelli alış ve satışı kapsar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sahibinden bedeli karşılığında almak ya da bir şeyi bedeli karşılığında başkasına vermektir; aynı değişimin alış ve satış yönleri birlikte ifade edilebilir.

facets.statement: Bedelli değişimde bir malı edinme ve elden çıkarma yönlerinin ikisini de kapsar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, alış ile satışın aynı bedelli değişimin birbirine bağlı iki yönü olduğunu ve ilgili kullanımın her iki yönü de gösterebildiğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bedelli bir değişimin hem edinme hem de elden çıkarma yönünün birlikte temsil edildiği genel kullanımlara uygundur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel sınır ve engel anlamı ile taşınmazın sınırları, iki su arasındaki ayırıcı ve sınır haline getirme yapıları birbirine karıştırılmadan korunur.

concept_map.definition: İki şeyi birbirinden ayıran sınır ya da engeldir. Bu çekirdek, bir taşınmazın çevre sınırlarını, iki su arasındaki ayırıcıyı ve bir şeyi sınır haline getirme eylemini kapsar.

facets.statement: İki şey arasına girerek onları ayıran bir sınır veya engel bulunur.
Bir evin ya da arazinin çevresini belirleyen sınırlar bu ayırma işlevinin yer bağlamındaki görünümüdür.
İki su kütlesi arasında duran ayırıcı, çekirdek engel anlamının özel bir uygulamasıdır.
Bir şeyi iki taraf arasında sınır olarak belirlemek, ad anlamından türeyen eylemli kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlam, iki şey arasında ayrım sağlayan sınır veya engeldir. Taşınmazın çevre çizgileri ile iki su arasındaki ayırıcı bu çekirdeğin belirli bağlamlardaki görünümleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dalı hem kişide veya şeyde bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük hem de eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık, ayıptan uzak durma ve başkasını onurlandırma alanı olarak kurar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu geniş çekirdeği doğru biçimde karşılar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, genel nitelik çekirdeğini ayrı tutar; belirli söz kalıpları, eylemler ve özel kullanımlar bu çekirdeğin bağımlı gerçekleşmeleri olarak gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişide, davranışta ya da şeyde kendi alanına göre bulunan övgüye değer üstünlük; insanda eli açıklık, bağışlayıcılık ve utanç verici olandan uzak durma biçiminde belirir. Başkasını onurlandırma ve ona küçültücü olmayan değerli bir yarar ulaştırma da bu anlam alanına girer.

facets.statement: Kişi, davranış veya şey kendi alanında üstün ve övgüye değer sayılır.
İnsandaki çekirdek görünüm eli açıklık, bol iyilik, bağışlayıcılık ve güzel huydur.
Başkasını onurlandırmak veya ona incitmeden değerli bir yarar sağlamak bu niteliğin eylemsel uzantısıdır.
Kişinin kendisini ayıp ve utanç verici işlerden uzak tutması, kendi değerini koruyan bir tutum olarak anlatılır.
Övgüye değer çocuklar dünyaya getirmek veya değerli bir bağ ya da varlık edinmek bu geniş niteliğin özel örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, övgüye değer üstünlük ile eli açıklık ve güzel huy çekirdeğinde birleşir; bağışlama, ayıptan kaçınma ve başkasını onurlandırma bu çekirdeğin başlıca görünümleridir. Övgüye değer çocuklar sahibi olmak ile değerli bir bağ ya da varlık edinmek de kaynakta verilen özel örneklerdir.
